question: Ustad Bismillah Khan was one of the greatest exponents of the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shehnai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct option is 4, Shehnai, as Ustad Bismillah Khan was a renowned Shehnai player and is often referred to as the "Shehnai Maestro".**
 
• The Shehnai is a wind instrument that originated in North India and is commonly used in Indian classical music and weddings.
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan was Indian maestro shehnai devoted.
 
 
• On March 21, 1916, the much-celebrated musician was born into the musicians' family.
 
• Ustad Bismillah has received prestigious awards, such as Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, Bharat Ratna, and Padma Vibhushan, and has become a worldwide famous name.
 
• He perfected the art of playing the shehnai and also had the distinction of playing in 1947 on the eve of the independence of Indian.
 
• Even today, the annual celebrations of Republic Day are broadcast to the opening notes of the music of Ustad Bismillah.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The flute** is a similar wind instrument but has a different sound and playing technique. It is also commonly used in Indian classical music.
 
• ** Tabla **is a percussion instrument consisting of two drums and is also commonly used in Indian classical music.
 
• ** The sitar **is a stringed instrument with a unique sound and playing technique. It is also commonly used in Indian classical music.
